reviewer_role: TC plan reviewer; this is not final implementation acceptance
decision: The reviewed plan is adequate to proceed through the H0 review gate and, after both required same-SHA reviews, the bounded H1 dependency/runtime qualification only. It does not authorize H2/H3/H4 product or test implementation. Their exact-SHA implementation contracts and TC ledgers must be independently reviewed before those stages begin.

findings.evidence: The plan preserves B03 deliverables and maps AT-05 human waits, AT-16 command_id redelivery after pre-delivery server failure, and AT-29 v1 compatibility during a v2 deployment, with REQ-05 as the direct B03 requirement. REQ-14 remains an explicit cross-requirement regression: H3 must verify P16 FAIL -> a new cycle at P07 human review -> mandatory P08-P16 re-evaluation, with no prior-cycle PASS or skip reused. This is plan coverage only; B05's integrated AT-09 remains pending and is not claimed executed.

The plan uses the original HumanSubmission schema and distinguishes its defined HTTP route from the currently absent FastAPI handler. It fixes P07 to complete-only because original P07 has no business-fail target or reject special outcome; P07 reject/needs_design/manual_result fail closed before consumption. P21 maps only complete/reject/needs_design to the original targets; manual_result is rejected. X01/X03 approvals remain on dedicated contracts.

The plan separates accepted, dispatched and applied; makes Temporal the process-transition authority; requires same-command idempotency and reconciliation of uncertain starts; keeps projection transactions idempotent; and reserves exact roles, SQL predicates and error tables for H2 review.

findings.topic: Crash, history retention and duplicate start boundary
findings.evidence: The final plan bounds uncertain-start retries by verified namespace retention, prohibits reusing known/closed execution IDs, requires a persisted run_id fence, and quarantines expired or missing history rather than starting blindly. H1/H2 must prove the actual CLI/server retention and negative cases before implementation acceptance.

The amended plan prohibits continue-as-new and workflow retry from replacing a pinned run. A future need requires an approved run-binding/fence inheritance contract and new crash/replay verification first. This closes an escape from the at-most-one effective execution and retained-history assertions; it does not claim that such replacement behavior has been implemented or tested.

The plan distinguishes B01 workflow_id from schema_version, keeps v1 workers/queues pinned, uses a distinct v2 test build/queue, prohibits silent old-history fallback, and requires real history replay rather than Replayer-only evidence for runtime routing.

B01 registry identity, G4 command semantics, G5 workspace READY, least-privilege roles and current authorization are preserved. The plan explicitly distinguishes original OpenAPI human/plan/notification routes from missing current handlers, and keeps B04 UI/SSE/artifacts separate. Workspace READY and HTTP 202 are not execution success.

H0 allows only reviewed plan/TC staging; H1 is limited to hash-verified SDK/CLI qualification and persistent local Temporal runtime checks. H2/H3/H4 detailed contracts and TC ledgers must receive same-SHA dual review before code/tests. H6 retains fresh G1-G5 plus targeted/full Node regressions and build checks; original AT completion is not inferred.

conditions_and_remaining_review: A separate reviewer must approve this exact plan SHA before H1 downloads, installation or Temporal runtime work.

H1 must verify actual pinned SDK/CLI APIs, persistent server history across restart, process cleanup, namespace retention/reuse policy, and that Temporal's own persistence is separate from IFPMIC PostgreSQL.
H2 must freeze exact migration, dispatcher claim/ack, least-privilege role, revision, event/projection and uncertain-start oracles with a new same-SHA TC review before implementation.
H3 must freeze an independent literal matrix for all 29 nodes, route outcomes, evidence, retries, cycles, skips, reconciliation and side-effect idempotency before implementation.
H4 must freeze exact per-task outcome/evidence/authorization mappings, task/notification transaction, artifact fixtures, stale revision and duplicate-submit behavior before implementation.
H5 needs a version-retention/retirement decision and a real deployment-routing verification; this review does not approve automatic upgrade or migration.

acceptance_boundary.original_AT_01_to_AT_32: not executed by this plan review

execution.read_only_validation: Reviewed the exact plan SHA against the corrected B03 source collection, TC risk matrix, original OpenAPI/workflow/state contracts, dependency metadata and protocol advice. No code, tests, dependencies, database migration or Temporal service were run or changed.
